'''Pat Dinelle''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2001 Montreal DPC]] on 18 August 2001 with Brangus, according to Eric George's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d2879">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-montreal-18-08-01d2879/ montreal-18-08-01], DeckTech (Eric "Inspecta_Dek" George, 21 August 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-08-21-montreal-18-08-01d2879/ GitHub Pages].</ref> In 2004 he posted on the [[Players Committee]] forum as PatThePotato, signing as Patrick Dinelle, and played with the Montreal Crew.<ref name="pcf-4007-55194">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55194#55194 My VC (Mike R.)], Patrick Dinelle (PatThePotato), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (16 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041031174412/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55156%26amp Internet Archive]</ref><ref name="pcf-4035-55547">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55547#55547 Toronto Star Wars Tourney!! Nov. 7], Patrick Dinelle (PatThePotato), Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (29 October 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20041104184026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=55278%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
